_readme: The one curated file behind /guides/. Edit it, then run: node scripts/apply-guide-template.js && node scripts/build-guides-hub.js && node scripts/inline-page-css.js && node scripts/sitemap-lastmod.js. lead + features + pillar + startHere pick the teasers on the front page (a slug may not repeat inside lead, features and startHere); sections lists the topics in page order (a topic with fewer than 3 articles is not shown and its articles fall back to "fallback"); articles is the registry: its ORDER is the order of the ItemList and of the GUIDES list in tests/content-assets.test.mjs (new articles go at the end; later = newer when two share a date), section is the one topic an article lives in, dek is the card standfirst (160 characters at most, no brand name), modified is the date of the last change to its text, figures or sources (omit it while it is the published date).
